entities.summary: Elin Anna Labba is a Sámi author and journalist from Sweden. She has won multiple prizes for her first book The Rocks Will Echo Our Sorrow: The Forced Displacement of the Northern Sámi, which describes the forced migration of the Sámi from Norway to Sweden from 1919 to 1920.
